name: search
description: Access real-time information from the internet. Use this for ANY query requiring current data: sports scores, news, stock prices, weather, people, companies, or general web research.

tools.name: search_searxng
tools.description: Web search using the locally hosted SearXNG instance — private, no API key. Its upstream engines may be blocked, in which case it returns an error naming them; prefer search_tavily for general queries.
examples: search for the latest news on AI
look up the stock price of AAPL
find information about the mars rover

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Fetch and extract the main text content from a URL using trafilatura. Use this after a web search when you need the full content of a page.
examples: fetch the content of the link

url.description: The full URL to fetch and read (e.g. https://www.espn.com/nba/standings).

tools.name: configure_search
tools.description: Configure the web search engine settings.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather conditions and 3-day forecast for any location. Returns temperature, humidity, wind, UV index, and daily highs/lows. Uses wttr.in — no API key needed.
examples: what is the weather in San Juan
how hot is it in New York today
will it rain tomorrow in Orlando

location.description: City name, optionally with state/country (e.g. San Juan Puerto Rico, Miami FL, London UK)

tools.name: search_tavily
tools.description: Web search via the Tavily API. Use this for world-state and current information requests. Returns a synthesised answer when Tavily provides one. Requires TAVILY_API_KEY in secrets.env.
